b6d8f9da3047891c179408bf937652d24d430b40.summary: IBM X-Force researchers report that Zeus Sphinx, a commercially sold banking Trojan that emerged in August 2015 against UK banks, has been found in Brazil. The Brazilian variant, Sphinx v2, targets online banking and Boleto payment services at three top Brazilian banks and one Colombian bank. It uses real-time webinjections to collect PINs and personal data, and can reroute Boleto payments to the criminal by generating altered barcodes. The malware is sold on underground forums.
